description: This file declares an interface for managing radio traffic harvesting settings, including setting and getting various periods and statuses related to radio traffic scans, as well as managing default values and override time-to-live (TTL).

methods.name: SetRISHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for radio traffic scans, returning 0 on success and 1 on failure.

methods.name: GetRISHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status, returning true if enabled.

methods.name: SetRISReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period for radio traffic scans in seconds.

methods.name: SetRISPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period for radio traffic scans in seconds.

methods.name: GetRISOverrideTTL
methods.description: Gets the timeout value after which the RIS intervals revert to default.

methods.name: SetRISOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the override timeout for RIS scans, in seconds.

methods.name: ValidateRISPeriod
methods.description: Validates the provided interval to ensure it falls within the valid range of values.
